title: /integrations/brunt
description: Instructions on how to set up Brunt Blind Engine within Home Assistant.
body:
The **Brunt Blind Engine**  allows one to control Blind Engines by [Brunt](https://www.brunt.co). To use it, you need a Brunt App Account. All Brunt Blind devices registered to your account are automatically added to your Home Assistant with the names given them through the Brunt app.

> **Warning:**
> This integration is not affiliated with Brunt and retrieves data from the endpoints of the mobile application. Use at your own risk.
